A portable engine for games made with Adv98V 1.70.54, the PC-9801 adventure engine of Cat's
Pro. Its first game is NOVA (1993). Adv98X runs the original scripts unmodified, in Japanese or
in Fuzion's English translation, and reproduces the PC-98 release: text, pictures, palette
effects, menus, click maps, saves and the FM music (with a light FM emulation made for these
machines).

This archive holds only the engine. It contains none of the game.
